lionel messi.name: Lionel Messi
lionel messi.description: Lionel Andrés Messi, also known as Leo Messi, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami and captains the Argentina national team.

cristiano ronaldo.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
cristiano ronaldo.description: Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League club Al Nassr and captains the Portugal national team.

kylian mbappe.name: Kylian Mbappé
kylian mbappe.description: Kylian Mbappé Lottin is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Real Madrid and captains the France national team.

erling haaland.name: Erling Haaland
erling haaland.description: Erling Braut Haaland is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Manchester City and the Norway national team.

jude bellingham.name: Jude Bellingham
jude bellingham.description: Jude Victor William Bellingham is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Real Madrid and the England national team.

neymar jr.name: Neymar Jr
neymar jr.description: Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior, known as Neymar Júnior, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League club Al Hilal and the Brazil national team.

vinicius jr.name: Vinícius Júnior
vinicius jr.description: Vinícius José Paixão de Oliveira Júnior, commonly known as Vinícius Júnior or Vini Jr., is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Brazil national team.

rodri.name: Rodri
rodri.description: Rodrigo Hernández Cascante, known as Rodri, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and the Spain national team.

harry kane.name: Harry Kane
harry kane.description: Harry Edward Kane is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich and captains the England national team.

mohamed salah.name: Mohamed Salah
mohamed salah.description: Mohamed Salah Hamed Mahrous Ghaly is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Liverpool and captains the Egypt national team.

kevin de bruyne.name: Kevin De Bruyne
kevin de bruyne.description: Kevin De Bruyne is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and the Belgium national team.

lamine yamal.name: Lamine Yamal
lamine yamal.description: Lamine Yamal Nasraoui Ebana is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.

robert lewandowski.name: Robert Lewandowski
robert lewandowski.description: Robert Lewandowski is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Barcelona and captains the Poland national team.

bukayo saka.name: Bukayo Saka
bukayo saka.description: Bukayo Ayoyinka TM Saka is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Premier League club Arsenal and the England national team.

martin odegaard.name: Martin Ødegaard
martin odegaard.description: Martin Ødegaard is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Arsenal and captains both Arsenal and the Norway national team.

antoine griezmann.name: Antoine Griezmann
antoine griezmann.description: Antoine Griezmann is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the France national team.

phil foden.name: Phil Foden
phil foden.description: Philip Walter Foden is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Premier League club Manchester City and the England national team.

jamal musiala.name: Jamal Musiala
jamal musiala.description: Jamal Musiala is a German professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich and the Germany national team.

florian wirtz.name: Florian Wirtz
florian wirtz.description: Florian Richard Wirtz is a German professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Germany national team.

lautaro martinez.name: Lautaro Martínez
lautaro martinez.description: Lautaro Javier Martínez is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Inter Milan and the Argentina national team.

rafael leao.name: Rafael Leão
rafael leao.description: Rafael Alexandre da Conceição Leão is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club AC Milan and the Portugal national team.

khvicha kvaratskhelia.name: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia
khvicha kvaratskhelia.description: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is a Georgian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club Napoli and the Georgia national team.

bruno fernandes.name: Bruno Fernandes
bruno fernandes.description: Bruno Miguel Borges Fernandes is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Manchester United and the Portugal national team.

marcus rashford.name: Marcus Rashford
marcus rashford.description: Marcus Rashford MBE is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Manchester United and the England national team.

son heung min.name: Son Heung-min
son heung min.description: Son Heung-min is a South Korean professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and captains the South Korea national team.

luis diaz.name: Luis Díaz
luis diaz.description: Luis Fernando Díaz Marulanda is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Liverpool and the Colombia national team.

frenkie de jong.name: Frenkie de Jong
frenkie de jong.description: Frenkie de Jong is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Netherlands national team.

pedri.name: Pedri
pedri.description: Pedro González López, known as Pedri, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.

gavi.name: Gavi
gavi.description: Pablo Martín Páez Gavira, known as Gavi, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.

federico valverde.name: Federico Valverde
federico valverde.description: Federico Santiago Valverde Dipetta is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Uruguay national team.

eduardo camavinga.name: Eduardo Camavinga
eduardo camavinga.description: Eduardo Celmi Camavinga is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Real Madrid and the France national team.

aurelien tchouameni.name: Aurélien Tchouaméni
aurelien tchouameni.description: Aurélien Djani Tchouaméni is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Real Madrid and the France national team.

declan rice.name: Declan Rice
declan rice.description: Declan Rice is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Arsenal and the England national team.

enzo fernandez.name: Enzo Fernández
enzo fernandez.description: Enzo Jeremías Fernández is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Chelsea and the Argentina national team.

cole palmer.name: Cole Palmer
cole palmer.description: Cole Jermaine Palmer is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Chelsea and the England national team.

alexis mac allister.name: Alexis Mac Allister
alexis mac allister.description: Alexis Mac Allister is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Liverpool and the Argentina national team.

virgil van dijk.name: Virgil van Dijk
virgil van dijk.description: Virgil van Dijk is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Premier League club Liverpool and captains the Netherlands national team.

ruben dias.name: Rúben Dias
ruben dias.description: Rúben Santos Gato Alves Dias is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the Portugal national team.

william saliba.name: William Saliba
william saliba.description: William Alain André Gabriel Saliba is a French professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Premier League club Arsenal and the France national team.

antonio rudiger.name: Antonio Rüdiger
antonio rudiger.description: Antonio Rüdiger is a German professional footballer who plays as a center-back for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Germany national team.

achraf hakimi.name: Achraf Hakimi
achraf hakimi.description: Achraf Hakimi Mouh is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Morocco national team.

theo hernandez.name: Theo Hernández
theo hernandez.description: Theo Bernard François Hernández is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Serie A club AC Milan and the France national team.

alisson becker.name: Alisson Becker
alisson becker.description: Alisson Ramses Becker, commonly known as Alisson, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Liverpool and the Brazil national team.

thibaut courtois.name: Thibaut Courtois
thibaut courtois.description: Thibaut Nicolas Marc Courtois is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Belgium national team.

ederson.name: Ederson
ederson.description: Ederson Santana de Moraes, known as Ederson, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Manchester City and the Brazil national team.

mike maignan.name: Mike Maignan
mike maignan.description: Mike Maignan is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club AC Milan and the France national team.

pele.name: Pelé
pele.description: Edson Arantes do Nascimento, known as Pelé, was a Brazilian professional footballer who played as a forward. Regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, he is the only player to have won three FIFA World Cups (1958, 1962, 1970).

diego maradona.name: Diego Maradona
diego maradona.description: Diego Armando Maradona was an Argentine professional football player and manager. Renowned for his masterful dribbling, vision, and ball control, he famously led Argentina to victory in the 1986 FIFA World Cup.

johan cruyff.name: Johan Cruyff
johan cruyff.description: Hendrik Johannes Cruijff was a Dutch professional football player and manager. A three-time Ballon d'Or winner, he was the primary architect and philosophy symbol of 'Total Football' with Ajax and Barcelona.

zinedine zidane.name: Zinedine Zidane
zinedine zidane.description: Zinedine Yazid Zidane, popularly dubbed Zizou, is a French former professional footballer who played as an attacking midfielder. He won the 1998 FIFA World Cup and the 1998 Ballon d'Or, praised for his elegance, vision, and technique.

ronaldo nazario.name: Ronaldo Nazário
ronaldo nazario.description: Ronaldo Luís Nazário de Lima, commonly known as Ronaldo Nazário or R9, is a Brazilian former professional footballer. A two-time Ballon d'Or winner and twice World Cup champion, he is celebrated as one of history's most devastating strikers.

franz beckenbauer.name: Franz Beckenbauer
franz beckenbauer.description: Franz Anton Beckenbauer was a German professional footballer and manager. Nicknamed Der Kaiser, he revolutionized the modern sweeper (libero) role, winning the World Cup both as a player (1974) and manager (1990).

alfredo di stefano.name: Alfredo Di Stéfano
alfredo di stefano.description: Alfredo Stéfano Di Stéfano Laulhé was an Argentine-born professional footballer and coach. Regarded as one of the most complete players in history, he spearheaded Real Madrid's dominance to win 5 consecutive European Cups.

michel platini.name: Michel Platini
michel platini.description: Michel François Platini is a French former football player and manager. He won the Ballon d'Or three times consecutively (1983, 1984, and 1985) and led France to victory in the 1984 European Championship.

ferenc puskas.name: Ferenc Puskás
ferenc puskas.description: Ferenc Puskás was a Hungarian footballer and manager, widely regarded as one of the greatest forwards and most prolific goalscorers ever. He was the talismanic leader of Hungary's legendary 'Magical Magyars'.

eusebio.name: Eusébio
eusebio.description: Eusébio da Silva Ferreira was a Portuguese footballer who played as a striker. Renowned for his speed, technique, and ferocious right-footed shot, he won the 1965 Ballon d'Or and finished top scorer at the 1966 World Cup.

george best.name: George Best
george best.description: George Best was a Northern Irish professional footballer who played as a winger for Manchester United. A highly charismatic, gifted dribbler, he won the Ballon d'Or in 1968 and is widely considered an iconic football maverick.

gerd muller.name: Gerd Müller
gerd muller.description: Gerhard 'Gerd' Müller was a German professional footballer. An extraordinarily clinical penalty box striker, he scored 68 goals in 62 games for West Germany and won the 1974 FIFA World Cup.

garrincha.name: Garrincha
garrincha.description: Manuel Francisco dos Santos, known by the nickname Garrincha, was a Brazilian professional footballer. Celebrated as the greatest dribbler in football history, he was instrumental in Brazil's 1958 and 1962 World Cup titles.

marco van basten.name: Marco van Basten
marco van basten.description: Marcel 'Marco' van Basten is a Dutch former professional football player. A three-time Ballon d'Or winner recognized for his incredible tactical intelligence and spectacular goals, his career was cut short at age 28 by severe ankle injuries.

paolo maldini.name: Paolo Maldini
paolo maldini.description: Paolo César Maldini is an Italian former professional footballer who played as a left-back and central defender. He spent all 25 seasons of his career with AC Milan, winning 5 UEFA Champions League titles.

lev yashin.name: Lev Yashin
lev yashin.description: Lev Ivanovich Yashin, nicknamed the 'Black Spider', was a Soviet professional footballer considered the greatest goalkeeper in the history of the sport. He remains the only goalkeeper ever to win the Ballon d'Or (1963).

ronaldinho.name: Ronaldinho
ronaldinho.description: Ronaldo de Assis Moreira, commonly known as Ronaldinho Gaúcho, is a Brazilian former professional footballer. Renowned for his technical skills, creativity, and flair, he won the Ballon d'Or in 2005 and the 2002 World Cup.

bobby charlton.name: Sir Bobby Charlton
bobby charlton.description: Sir Robert Charlton CBE was an English professional footballer who played as a midfielder. Regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, he won the 1966 FIFA World Cup and the 1966 Ballon d'Or.

romario.name: Romário
romario.description: Romário de Souza Faria is a Brazilian former professional footballer. A clinical striker famed for his explosive speed in short spaces, he spearheaded Brazil's 1994 FIFA World Cup triumph, earning the Golden Ball.

bobby moore.name: Bobby Moore
bobby moore.description: Robert Frederick Chelsea Moore OBE was an English professional footballer. He captained West Ham United and was the iconic captain of the England national team that won the 1966 FIFA World Cup.

franco baresi.name: Franco Baresi
franco baresi.description: Franchino Baresi is an Italian former professional football player and coach. He spent his entire 20-year career with AC Milan, captaining the club for 15 seasons and winning 3 European Cups.

zico.name: Zico
zico.description: Arthur Antunes Coimbra, known as Zico, is a Brazilian former footballer. Often called the 'White Pelé', he was a creative playmaker with exceptional passing vision and is ranked as one of the best free-kick takers ever.

ruud gullit.name: Ruud Gullit
ruud gullit.description: Ruud Gullit is a Dutch former professional footballer. A highly versatile player who won the Ballon d'Or in 1987, he captained the Netherlands national team to victory at UEFA Euro 1988.

lothar matthaus.name: Lothar Matthäus
lothar matthaus.description: Lothar Herbert Matthäus is a German former professional footballer. He captained West Germany to victory in the 1990 FIFA World Cup where he won the Ballon d'Or, and remains Germany's most capped player.

socrates.name: Sócrates
socrates.description: Sócrates Brasileiro Sampaio de Souza Vieira de Oliveira was a Brazilian footballer. A deep-lying playmaker famed for his medical degree, political activism, and elegant backheels, he captained Brazil at the 1982 World Cup.

gianluigi buffon.name: Gianluigi Buffon
gianluigi buffon.description: Gianluigi Buffon Ufficiale OMRI is an Italian former professional goalkeeper. Famed for his incredible consistency and leadership over a 28-year career, he won the 2006 FIFA World Cup with Italy.

roberto baggio.name: Roberto Baggio
roberto baggio.description: Roberto Baggio is an Italian former professional footballer who played mainly as a second striker. He won the Ballon d'Or in 1993 and is universally celebrated for his technical mastery, flair, and playmaking wizardry.

thierry henry.name: Thierry Henry
thierry henry.description: Thierry Daniel Henry is a French professional football coach and former player. Considered one of the greatest strikers in Premier League history, he became Arsenal's all-time top scorer and won both the 1998 World Cup and Euro 2000.

dennis bergkamp.name: Dennis Bergkamp
dennis bergkamp.description: Dennis Nicolaas Maria Bergkamp is a Dutch professional football coach and former player. Celebrated for his sublime technical mastery and elegant touch, his link-up play made him an iconic figure in Arsenal's 'Invincibles' squad.

rivaldo.name: Rivaldo
rivaldo.description: Rivaldo Vítor Borba Ferreira is a Brazilian former professional footballer. Known for his bending free kicks, overhead kicks, and powerful ball striking, he won the 1999 Ballon d'Or and the 2002 FIFA World Cup.

roberto carlos.name: Roberto Carlos
roberto carlos.description: Roberto Carlos da Silva Rocha is a Brazilian former professional footballer. Widely considered one of the greatest left-backs in history, he was famous for his stamina, running speed, and incredibly powerful free kicks.

cafu.name: Cafu
cafu.description: Marcos Evangelista de Morais, known as Cafu, is a Brazilian former professional footballer. He is the most internationally capped Brazilian male player and the only player to appear in three consecutive World Cup finals, winning two.

gabriel batistuta.name: Gabriel Batistuta
gabriel batistuta.description: Gabriel Omar Batistuta, nicknamed 'Batigol', is an Argentine former professional footballer. One of the most lethal and powerful strikers of his generation, he is Fiorentina's all-time top scorer in Serie A.

javier zanetti.name: Javier Zanetti
javier zanetti.description: Javier Adelmar Zanetti is an Argentine former professional footballer. Nicknamed 'El Tractor' for his stamina and tireless runs, he captained Inter Milan for over a decade, leading them to a historic treble in 2010.

francesco totti.name: Francesco Totti
francesco totti.description: Francesco Totti is an Italian former professional footballer who played solely for Roma and the Italy national team. A creative playmaker renowned for his vision and loyalty, he won the 2006 FIFA World Cup.

alessandro del piero.name: Alessandro Del Piero
alessandro del piero.description: Alessandro Del Piero is an Italian former professional footballer. A technically gifted and creative supporting forward, he is Juventus' all-time top goalscorer and won the 2006 FIFA World Cup.

fabio cannavaro.name: Fabio Cannavaro
fabio cannavaro.description: Fabio Cannavaro is an Italian former professional footballer and manager. He captained Italy to victory in the 2006 FIFA World Cup, which earned him the Ballon d'Or, making him one of the few defenders to win the award.

alessandro nesta.name: Alessandro Nesta
alessandro nesta.description: Alessandro Nesta is an Italian professional football manager and former player. Widely considered one of the best center-backs of his generation, he was renowned for his pace, artistic tackles, and elegance on the ball.

dino zoff.name: Dino Zoff
dino zoff.description: Dino Zoff is an Italian former professional football goalkeeper. He is the oldest ever winner of the World Cup, which he earned as captain of the Italian national team in 1982 at the age of 40.

frank rijkaard.name: Frank Rijkaard
frank rijkaard.description: Franklin Edmundo Rijkaard is a Dutch former footballer and manager. A complete and versatile player, he formed a legendary Dutch trio at AC Milan and later managed Barcelona to Champions League success.

clarence seedorf.name: Clarence Seedorf
clarence seedorf.description: Clarence Clyde Seedorf is a Dutch professional football manager and former player. Regarded as one of the best midfielders of his generation, he is the only player to have won the Champions League with three different clubs.

peter schmeichel.name: Peter Schmeichel
peter schmeichel.description: Peter Bolesław Schmeichel is a Danish former professional footballer. An intimidating goalkeeper famous for his 'star jump' saves, he was a key figure in Manchester United's 1999 treble and Denmark's Euro 1992 win.

eric cantona.name: Eric Cantona
eric cantona.description: Eric Daniel Pierre Cantona is a French actor and former professional footballer. A charismatic and enigmatic figure, 'King Eric' is credited with reviving Manchester United's fortunes in the early 1990s.

roy keane.name: Roy Keane
roy keane.description: Roy Maurice Keane is an Irish football pundit, manager, and former professional player. Known for his aggressive, highly competitive style of play, he was the driving force and captain of Manchester United for over a decade.

paul scholes.name: Paul Scholes
paul scholes.description: Paul Scholes is an English football coach and former player. He spent his entire professional playing career with Manchester United, renowned for his exceptional passing range, vision, and long-range shooting.

wayne rooney.name: Wayne Rooney
wayne rooney.description: Wayne Mark Rooney is an English professional football manager and former player. A versatile and aggressive attacker, he is the all-time record goalscorer for Manchester United and was long the record scorer for England.

alan shearer.name: Alan Shearer
alan shearer.description: Alan Shearer CBE is an English football pundit and former professional player. A classic number 9, he remains the all-time top goalscorer in the history of the Premier League with 260 goals.

michael laudrup.name: Michael Laudrup
michael laudrup.description: Michael Laudrup is a Danish former professional footballer and manager. Widely regarded as one of the greatest playmakers of all time, he was a key member of Johan Cruyff's 'Dream Team' at Barcelona.

hristo stoichkov.name: Hristo Stoichkov
hristo stoichkov.description: Hristo Stoichkov is a Bulgarian former professional footballer. A prolific forward known for his explosive temper and lethal left foot, he won the Ballon d'Or in 1994 after leading Bulgaria to the World Cup semi-finals.

gheorghe hagi.name: Gheorghe Hagi
gheorghe hagi.description: Gheorghe Hagi is a Romanian football manager and former professional player. Nicknamed 'The Maradona of the Carpathians', he was famous for his creativity, dribbling, and spectacular long-range strikes.

pavel nedved.name: Pavel Nedvěd
pavel nedved.description: Pavel Nedvěd is a Czech former professional footballer. Nicknamed 'The Czech Fury' for his endless stamina, energetic runs, and powerful shooting, he won the Ballon d'Or in 2003 with Juventus.

andriy shevchenko.name: Andriy Shevchenko
andriy shevchenko.description: Andriy Mykolayovych Shevchenko is a Ukrainian football manager and former player. A devastatingly complete striker, he won the 2004 Ballon d'Or and remains AC Milan's second all-time top goalscorer.

george weah.name: George Weah
george weah.description: George Manneh Oppong Weah is a Liberian politician and former professional footballer. Blending immense physical power with breathtaking skill, he became the first and only African player to win the Ballon d'Or in 1995.

didier drogba.name: Didier Drogba
didier drogba.description: Didier Yves Drogba Tébily is an Ivorian former professional footballer. A supreme big-game player with incredible physical strength and aerial ability, he cemented his legacy by winning the 2012 Champions League with Chelsea.

samuel etoo.name: Samuel Eto'o
samuel etoo.description: Samuel Eto'o Fils is a Cameroonian football administrator and former player. One of the greatest African players of all time, he uniquely won back-to-back European continental trebles with Barcelona and Inter Milan.

miroslav klose.name: Miroslav Klose
miroslav klose.description: Miroslav Josef Klose is a German professional football manager and former player. A lethal penalty-box poacher, he holds the record for the most goals scored in FIFA World Cup tournaments with 16 goals.

arjen robben.name: Arjen Robben
arjen robben.description: Arjen Robben is a Dutch former professional footballer. Known for his dribbling skills, speed, and trademark move of cutting inside from the right wing to shoot with his left foot, he won the 2013 Champions League with Bayern.

franck ribery.name: Franck Ribéry
franck ribery.description: Franck Henry Pierre Ribéry is a French former professional footballer. A fast, tricky, and excellent dribbler, he formed a legendary wing partnership with Arjen Robben at Bayern Munich, winning a historic treble in 2013.

gareth bale.name: Gareth Bale
gareth bale.description: Gareth Frank Bale is a Welsh former professional footballer. Renowned for his explosive pace, powerful left foot, and ability to score spectacular goals in finals, he won five UEFA Champions League titles with Real Madrid.

sergio aguero.name: Sergio Agüero
sergio aguero.description: Sergio Leonel Agüero del Castillo, also known as Kun Agüero, is an Argentine former professional footballer. He is Manchester City's all-time top goalscorer and famously scored the stoppage-time winner to secure their 2012 Premier League title.

hugo sanchez.name: Hugo Sánchez
hugo sanchez.description: Hugo Sánchez Márquez is a Mexican former professional footballer and manager. A spectacular goalscorer known for his acrobatic volleys and bicycle kicks, he won five consecutive La Liga titles with Real Madrid.

carlos alberto.name: Carlos Alberto
carlos alberto.description: Carlos Alberto Torres was a Brazilian football player and manager. He captained the legendary Brazil team to victory in the 1970 World Cup, scoring the fourth goal in the final, considered one of the greatest goals in tournament history.

jairzinho.name: Jairzinho
jairzinho.description: Jair Ventura Filho, better known as Jairzinho, is a Brazilian former footballer. Known as 'The Hurricane' for his devastating pace and power, he uniquely scored in every single match of Brazil's triumphant 1970 World Cup campaign.

mario kempes.name: Mario Kempes
mario kempes.description: Mario Alberto Kempes Chiodi is an Argentine former professional footballer. He was the catalyst for Argentina's 1978 World Cup victory, finishing as the tournament's top scorer and best player.
